triples.subject: convertible devices
triples.evidence: VivoTab is a series of Microsoft Windows hybrid tablet computers designed by Asus . It is a sub - series of the Vivo series by Asus . The name is derived from the Latin word " to live " and , along with Asus 's Transformer series of convertible devices running Windows , is a primary competitor to the Microsoft Surface . The family is made up of the VivoTab , VivoTab RT , VivoTab RT 3 G , VivoTab RT LTE , VivoTab Smart , and later on the VivoTab Note 8 .
